verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a back-office and compliance SaaS, so bulk actions across many items (mail, filings, states) are a fair axis. The evidence does not document any bulk-operation capability. The only related claim is that users can apply to more than one partner service at a time, which is a multi-application convenience rather than bulk operations across items. Probes found no API or OpenAPI spec that could enable programmatic bulk actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
